, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner chose to “use start-of-term year to standardize dates,” even though the question explicitly asks when the city “elected” its first Black mayor. This conflated election year (1977) with start-of-term year (1978), creating unnecessary confusion and risk of giving the wrong specific year, despite the correct decade still being the 1970s.
